title: Reconcile and define Personhood Continuity architecture
originating_goal: Make governed intergenerational personhood continuity a durable StegVerse development capability rather than a conversation-dependent idea.
dependencies: Read StegCore permission/admissibility handoff before reuse or mutation.
Read current Continuity/StegID continuity handoff before assigning evidence authority.
Read current Governance handoff before defining disclosure authority.
Read current StegTalk/Auri handoff before defining conversational access.
Detect existing schemas or tasks that already satisfy any Personhood Continuity requirement.
required_outputs: architecture ownership map across StegCore, Continuity/StegID, Governance, and StegTalk/Auri
smallest canonical personhood-record schema that does not duplicate existing continuity primitives
contemporaneous reconstruction vs retrospective analysis contract
test requirements for unsupported inference, contradictory evidence, temporal drift, unauthorized disclosure, and historical mutation
explicit downstream task/handoff destinations for implementation
core_invariants: The represented person controls availability subject to valid governance constraints.
AI inference must remain distinguishable from direct testimony, observed behavior, third-party testimony, contemporaneous context, outcome evidence, and later reflection.
Future analytical methods may increase interpretive resolution without mutating historical evidence.
Technical provenance remains hidden from ordinary interaction unless requested or necessary.
Persona simulation is separate from the historical personhood record and requires separate explicit authority.
collision_boundaries: Do not create a parallel identity or continuity authority in StegCore.
Do not create a parallel governance authority if disclosure policy already belongs elsewhere.
Do not treat stored information as automatically discloseable.
Do not expose third-party private evidence merely because the represented person preserved it.
Do not rewrite derived inference into historical fact.
Do not use model output as disclosure or execution authority.
Do not use GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, STEGVERSE_GITHUB_TOKEN, or any non-TV/TVC credential fallback.
next_task_after_complete: Install repository-specific implementation tasks only after ownership reconciliation proves the correct destination for each required primitive.
